name: Vanku Tiger-Stone
summary: Electric paving machine, up to 6 m wide, that lays a whole street of concrete or clay pavers in one pass, edge stones included. Pavers on the machine place the stones in the pattern on a sliding board; the machine drives itself along the kerb with a road-tracking system and is moved into position by remote control.

germany.statusNote: Dutch maker Vanku B.V. takes enquiries by e-mail and contact form; no German dealer or price found. The website and the machine itself also invite enquiries for licensing and production, so supply may run through licensees. A copy of the maker brochure is hosted by the Danish builders' merchant Bygma, but no Bygma sales page was read.

notes: Not fully unmanned: workers standing on the machine take stones from the hopper and set the pattern on the sliding board; the machine then lays the whole width and drives on at the push of a button.
Hopper is filled by a loader; suits new and reused stones and lays the edge finishing directly, so no cutting is needed (maker).
